sloka: रावणान्तःपुरे रुद्धा राक्षसीभिः सुरक्षिता ।एकवेणीधरा दीना त्वयि चिन्तापरायणा ।। ५.६५.१३ ।।।।
transliteration: rāvaṇāntaḥpure ruddhā rākṣasībhiḥ surakṣitā ।ekaveṇīdharā dīnā tvayi cintāparāyaṇā ।। 5.65.13 ।।।।

translations.english: "Sita, who did not deserve and yet was full of grief was detained by Ravana in his inner palace, guarded by ogresses. She had single braid (a sign of desolation), was pathetic, and totally absorbed in your thought. She was lying on bare ground with her limbs turned pale, like lotus in winter. She was averse to Ravana and was determined to commit suicide. She has only Rama in her mind. Somehow I found her.
